title: 0045 고객 A/S 접수 — 서버만 쓴다, 고객은 자기 것 · 팩토리 구성원은 자기 팩토리 것만 읽는다, 간 곳(담당자 · 대표 · 실장)과 담당자 칸은 같이, 상태는 requested → received → done · requested → cancelled 만 · 때는 트리거, 내용은 그대로, 지우기 없음, 비공개 사진 버킷 (scripts/rls-probe.mjs --migration database/migrations/0043_order_reports.sql --migration database/migrations/0045_as_requests.sql)
setup: INSERT INTO public.companies (id, kind, name, plan, status) VALUES ({{company_x}}, 'partner', 'probe X', 'agent', 'active'), ({{company_y}}, 'partner', 'probe Y', 'expert', 'active')

INSERT INTO public.designs (id, user_id, name, company_id) VALUES ({{design_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'probe', {{company_x}})

INSERT INTO public.design_documents (id, design_id, snapshot_id, doc_type, rev, doc_no, title, render_payload, content_hash) VALUES ({{doc_x}}, {{design_x}}, {{snap_x}}, 'work_order', 1, 'probe-' || {{doc_x}}::text, 'probe', '{}', 'probe')

INSERT INTO public.orders (id, order_no, design_id, document_id, snapshot_id, contract_amount, company_id, customer_name) VALUES ({{order_x}}, 'probe-' || {{order_x}}::text, {{design_x}}, {{doc_x}}, {{snap_x}}, 0, {{company_x}}, '고객A')

INSERT INTO public.as_requests (id, company_id, order_id, customer_user_id, body, route, assignee_id) VALUES ({{as_a}}, {{company_x}}, {{order_x}}, {{customer_user}}, '문이 안 닫혀요', 'assignee', {{x_staff_user}})
INSERT INTO public.as_requests (id, company_id, order_id, customer_user_id, body, route) VALUES ({{as_b}}, {{company_x}}, {{order_x}}, {{customer_user}}, '서랍이 걸려요', 'owners')

checks.name: 읽기 — 고객 자기 것 · 그 팩토리 구성원 (남 · 남의 팩토리 0, 익명 deny)
checks.sql: select count(*) from public.as_requests where id = {{as_a}}

checks.name: 고객 · 구성원은 쓰지 못한다
checks.sql: insert into public.as_requests (company_id, order_id, customer_user_id, body, route) values ({{company_x}}, {{order_x}}, {{customer_user}}, '또', 'owners')

checks.name: 서버 — 대표 · 실장에게 간 접수 (담당자 칸 비움)
checks.sql: insert into public.as_requests (company_id, order_id, customer_user_id, body, route) values ({{company_x}}, {{order_x}}, {{customer_user}}, '서랍이 걸려요', 'owners')

checks.name: 간 곳이 담당자인데 담당자 칸이 비면 거절
checks.sql: insert into public.as_requests (company_id, order_id, customer_user_id, body, route) values ({{company_x}}, {{order_x}}, {{customer_user}}, '내용', 'assignee')

checks.name: 빈 내용은 거절
checks.sql: insert into public.as_requests (company_id, order_id, customer_user_id, body, route) values ({{company_x}}, {{order_x}}, {{customer_user}}, '   ', 'owners')

checks.name: 같은 팩토리 수주만
checks.sql: insert into public.as_requests (company_id, order_id, customer_user_id, body, route) values ({{company_y}}, {{order_x}}, {{customer_user}}, '내용', 'owners')

checks.name: 받기 → 끝 — 때는 트리거가 찍는다
checks.sql: update public.as_requests set state = 'received', received_by = {{x_staff_user}} where id = {{as_a}}; update public.as_requests set state = 'done' where id = {{as_a}}; select state || '/' || (received_at is not null) || '/' || (done_at is not null) from public.as_requests where id = {{as_a}}

checks.name: 받지 않고 바로 끝은 안 된다
checks.sql: update public.as_requests set state = 'done' where id = {{as_b}}

checks.name: 고객이 거두기 — 접수 상태에서만
checks.sql: update public.as_requests set state = 'cancelled' where id = {{as_b}}; select state || '/' || (cancelled_at is not null) from public.as_requests where id = {{as_b}}

checks.name: 내용은 바꿀 수 없다
checks.sql: update public.as_requests set body = '바꿈' where id = {{as_a}}

checks.name: 48시간 알림 시각은 상태와 따로 적는다
checks.sql: update public.as_requests set alerted_at = now() where id = {{as_a}}; select (alerted_at is not null)::text from public.as_requests where id = {{as_a}}

checks.name: 사진 버킷 — 비공개 · 5MB · JPEG · PNG
checks.sql: select public || '/' || file_size_limit || '/' || array_to_string(allowed_mime_types, ',') from storage.buckets where id = 'as-request-photos'
